summary: Marex Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K on November 5, 2026, attaching an exhibit with its third-quarter 2026 earnings release. The filing reports record results: Q3 revenue of $743.2m (+53% y/y), Adjusted Profit Before Tax of $176.1m (+75%), Profit After Tax of $130.3m (+78%), and Adjusted Basic EPS of $1.75 (+73%); nine-month revenue was $2,131.3m (+47%) and Adjusted PBT $494.7m (+63%). Management cites acquisition execution, clearing momentum, prime balances, FX and market-making growth. This is routine earnings disclosure, not a special situation; watch for further M&A pipeline updates.
